questions.output: Gender disparities in EU jobs focused on digital and green transitions are exacerbated by the underrepresentation of women in high-digital-intensity occupations, their overrepresentation in care work, and the risk of gender imbalance in green-task jobs due to automation and task content [p:hr-876]. Additionally, the digital transition can hinder individuals with disabilities from performing tasks effectively, further complicating their employment situation [p:hr-929].
